name: Bandage
description: Restores 30 health. Press H.

name: Purified Water
description: Restores 50 water. Press G.

name: Energy Bar
description: Restores 15 health and 15 water.

name: Radio Valve
description: A glass valve from an old transmitter. The Outpost's radio mast is missing one.

name: Seed Tin
description: A sealed tin of vegetable seeds. Soil at the Outpost could use them.

name: Filter Cartridge
description: A fresh charcoal cartridge. The Factory's drinking fountain takes this size.

name: Old Photograph
description: A faded photo of a woman in a lab coat, laughing. Old Tobi might recognise it.

name: Old Photograph
description: A photo of a sorting line at dawn, two coffee cups on a rail. Old Tobi might recognise it.

name: Old Photograph
description: A photo of two people swimming in a clear river. Old Tobi might recognise it.

name: Old Photograph
description: A photo of a truck full of compost at a farm gate. Old Tobi might recognise it.

name: Old Photograph
description: A photo of a man on a rooftop holding a power cable. Old Tobi might recognise it.

name: Copper Ore
description: Green-streaked rock with copper in it. A workbench can make something of it.

name: Iron Ore
description: Heavy, rust-red rock. Smelted, it is steel again.

name: Crystal Shard
description: Quartz from deep in the mine. It holds light, and charge.

name: Coal
description: Old fuel. The workbench's forge burns it.

name: Pickaxe
description: A miner's pick. Swing at ore veins (J) to break them.

name: Rusty Key
description: A heavy old key. Some door down here still takes it.

name: Metro Service Key
description: Blue tag: 'MAINTENANCE ONLY'. Opens the service doors in the old metro.

name: Rune Battery
description: A crystal cell. Restores 50 rune energy.

name: Shotgun Shell
description: For the Scatter rune's shotgun, two at a time. Rare: keep them for when it counts.
